sourceProof.interval: Open architectural panels keep original full-height opaque paper, lattice, glow, gapW and open/close clocks. Lyric recipe changes only source-local y, preserving local x/font/size/all glyphs, and solver world offset is exactly zero. All glyph ink remains inside stage y and full-open gap x. At every clock the foreground paper union spans full stage y, so each glyph-relative point has the identical local-x paper-occlusion membership before/after. The identical root camera preserves this membership. Thus no new panel occlusion or shortened readable clock is introduced. Shadow/filter variant remains unsupported.
sourceProof.stageProof: All primary lyric ink stays inside native stage y and the unchanged source aperture. Full-height opaque foreground architectural panels remain fixed in native source coordinates and replay with zero world offset. Every clock preserves the same local-x occlusion membership.
sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly

sourceProof.interval: Open architectural panels keep original full-height opaque paper, lattice, glow, gapW and open/close clocks. Lyric recipe changes only source-local y, preserving local x/font/size/all glyphs, and solver world offset is exactly zero. All glyph ink remains inside stage y and full-open gap x. At every clock the foreground paper union spans full stage y, so each glyph-relative point has the identical local-x paper-occlusion membership before/after. The identical root camera preserves this membership. Thus no new panel occlusion or shortened readable clock is introduced. Shadow/filter variant remains unsupported.
sourceProof.stageProof: All primary lyric ink stays inside native stage y and the unchanged source aperture. Full-height opaque foreground architectural panels remain fixed in native source coordinates and replay with zero world offset. Every clock preserves the same local-x occlusion membership.
sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly
